thread:
jordan: quick heads-up — TLS posture scan just flagged a region-wide failure in eu-west-1: ~3k open TLS sessions showing weak-cipher fallbacks and a surprising amount of 0-RTT. scan id scan-2026-03-23-17. anyone touched RBAC or cert fetching yesterday? :eyes:

sec-bot: automated alert: posture-scan/1787654322 -> severity: high. samples uploaded: https://ci.internal/scans/scan-1787654322

ravi: we did tighten some RBAC last night — PR #2418 removed `keystore.read` for service-account `sni-fetcher`. could that cause proxies to fallback to legacy path when certs can't be fetched?

elaine: seeing many handshake logs with fallback ciphers. example snippet from proxy logs: `proxy: handshake fallback from ECDHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256 -> AES256-SHA`

kai: yup — if keystore reads fail the proxy codepath falls back to a software TLS stack with a conservative/legacy cipher list. quick mitigation is to restore the keystore read or add an allowlist to avoid fallback. rollback is fastest.

olivia: also seeing 0-RTT spikes on the edge gateway in eu-west-1. recommend disabling early_data on the gateway as a stopgap: `edge.gateway.tls.early_data = false`

ravi: confirming the RBAC change contained `remove: proxy-keystore: read`. i can revert the PR in ~10m. after revert, do we also need a cert rotation?

jordan: revert first. also enable/verify audit logging for keystore reads so we can correlate. runbook: 1) Ravi revert PR; 2) Kai flip early_data off in eu-west; 3) Elaine gather handshake samples + PCAPs and push to incident bucket; 4) Olivia check KMS decrypt error spikes; 5) report status here. i'll open an incident channel and link the doc.

sec-bot: incident created: #incident-tls-fallback-1787654322

kai: mitigation in progress — set early_data=false in eu-west canary (5% -> 100%). observing handshake success rate rise: 86% -> 99% over the last 6m.

ravi: reverted RBAC change and re-granted `keystore.read` to `sni-fetcher` role. KMS decrypt errors stop appearing in logs. sample: `kms: decrypt ok for key/redwood-edge`

elaine: uploaded handshake samples + pcap to /mnt/incidents/1787654322/handshake-samples.tar.gz. noticed a tail of legacy clients still negotiating TLS1.0 due to compat mode — will ping client teams separate.

olivia: KMS logs show a short 503 spike at 03:12:45 UTC in apac during the RBAC roll window. looks transient but correlated; opening ops ticket for deeper triage.

jordan: status update: mitigations applied, metrics back to baseline. next actions: write postmortem, add RBAC deploy guardrails (smoke test for keystore reads), add CI keystore-read integration test, default disable 0-RTT on gateways, and add alerting for proxy weak-cipher fallback events. assigning owners/timelines in the incident doc.

ravi: +1 on CI smoke test. i'll own the RBAC checklist update — ETA EOD.

elaine: i'll lead the postmortem write-up and include timeline + handshake artifacts.

olivia: i'll own the KMS ops ticket and follow up with root cause if any backend issue.

jordan: thanks all — great turnaround. :thumbsup:
